# iru_devices (Data Source)

Look up Iru devices. Filters are passed to the API; `serial_number`, `device_name` and `user_email` match by substring.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every Mac on a blueprint.
data "iru_devices" "core_macs" {
  blueprint_id = iru_blueprint.core.id
  platform     = "Mac"
}

output "core_mac_serials" {
  value = data.iru_devices.core_macs.results[*].serial_number
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `asset_tag` (String) Only devices with this asset tag.
- `blueprint_id` (String) Only devices on this blueprint.
- `device_name` (String) Devices whose name contains this value.
- `platform` (String) Only devices on this platform: `Mac`, `iPhone`, `iPad` or `AppleTV`.
- `serial_number` (String) Devices whose serial number contains this value.
- `user_email` (String) Devices whose assigned user's email contains this value.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) Matching devices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `agent_installed` (Boolean) Whether the Iru agent is installed.
- `agent_version` (String) Iru agent version.
- `asset_tag` (String) Asset tag.
- `blueprint_id` (String) Blueprint ID.
- `blueprint_name` (String) Blueprint name.
- `first_enrollment` (String) First enrollment time.
- `id` (String) Device ID.
- `is_missing` (Boolean) Whether the device is marked missing.
- `is_removed` (Boolean) Whether the device has been removed.
- `last_check_in` (String) Last check-in time.
- `last_enrollment` (String) Last enrollment time.
- `mdm_enabled` (Boolean) Whether MDM is enabled.
- `model` (String) Hardware model.
- `name` (String) Device name.
- `os_version` (String) OS version.
- `platform` (String) `Mac`, `iPhone`, `iPad` or `AppleTV`.
- `serial_number` (String) Serial number.
- `tags` (List of String) Tag names.
- `user_email` (String) Assigned user's email; null when unassigned.
- `user_id` (String) Assigned user's ID; null when unassigned.
- `user_name` (String) Assigned user's name; null when unassigned.
